action.thought:
The bug is clear. On line 245, when `right` is already a computed ndarray (from a nested CompoundModel), the code sets `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1` — filling with all ones — instead of copying the actual values from `right`. This destroys the separability information of the nested model.

The fix is to replace `= 1` with `= right`:
